title: Seating
intro: Tables for each venue, who sits where, and the tables guests see on their invitations.
exportsLink: Seating chart and place cards: Exports
refused: Seating is not available to your role on this event.
readOnly: Your role can see the seating but not change it.

publish.title: Guests see their tables
publish.since: Guests see their own household’s tables on their personal invitations since {{when}}.
publish.notYet: Guests don’t see their tables yet.
publish.live: Changes to the seating show on their invitations at once; nobody else’s table is shown.
publish.notOpen: Guests can’t open their invitations yet: they will see their tables once the invitation is published.
publish.hide: Take the tables off guests’ pages

summary.title: This plan
summary.hidden: Guests don’t see this venue, but it has tables. Its seats stay as they are.
summary.unspecified: These tables belong to no venue.
summary.unspecifiedHeld: Guests answer per venue, so seats here stay held until you move or unseat their guests.

auto.title: Automatic seating
auto.explain: Seats everyone coming who has no seat yet. It adds to the plan: it never moves anyone, keeps each household at one table and never goes over a table’s seats or the venue’s capacity.
auto.nobody: Everyone coming has a seat in this plan.

progress.retrying: Something changed while it was planning; trying again with the latest list (attempt {{attempt}} of {{total}})…
progress.timedOut: Still running. It carries on without this page; check again in a moment.

result.title: The result
result.nobody: Nobody was waiting for a seat.
result.needTable_other: These {{count, number}} households need a table:
result.unknownHousehold: Household not on the list any more
result.stale: The guest list or the seating has changed since this run. The tables below are the current ones.

reasons.venueFull_one: The venue has no room left for {{count, number}} more person.
reasons.venueFull_other: The venue has no room left for {{count, number}} more people.
reasons.householdTableFull: The table where this household already sits is full. Move them, or give that table more seats.
reasons.noTables: This plan has no tables yet.
reasons.tablesFull: Every table is full. Add a table or give one more seats.
reasons.noTableFits_one: No table has {{count, number}} free seat.
reasons.noTableFits_other: No table has {{count, number}} free seats together. Add a table or give one more seats.

failures.title: Automatic seating didn’t finish
failures.stateChanged: The guest list or the tables kept changing while it was planning, so nothing was seated. Run it again.
failures.accessRevoked: The person who started it can no longer change the seating, so nothing was seated.
failures.eventUnavailable: The event is archived or no longer available, so nothing was seated.
failures.tooLarge: This plan is too large to seat automatically. Seat guests by hand, or contact support.
failures.failed: It couldn’t finish, and nothing was seated. Run it again.

tables.title: Tables
tables.empty: No tables yet. Add one, or several at once.
tables.noRoomAgain: No free seat here to seat them again.

toSeat.title: Coming, not seated yet
toSeat.intro: Households in the guest list’s order, with the people coming here who have no seat in this plan.
toSeat.empty: Everyone coming has a seat in this plan.
toSeat.nobodyComing: Nobody has said they are coming here yet.
toSeat.refused: The guest list is not available to your role, so who is coming can’t be shown.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameHelp: Guests see this name on their invitations.
dialog.capacityHelp_one: At least {{count, number}}: one guest is seated here.
dialog.capacityHelp_other: At least {{count, number}}: that many guests are seated here.
dialog.zoneHelp: A part of the room, such as “Terrace”. Only you see it.
dialog.prefixHelp: Numbered after it: “Table 1”, “Table 2”, and on from the highest number already used.
dialog.venueHelp: Moving it takes it off the drawn plan: you place it again in the new room.
dialog.venueOccupied: Guests or freed seats are on this table: move them and dismiss the notes before changing its venue.

seat.homeFull: {{table}}, where their household sits, has no room for everyone.
seat.noRoom_one: No table has a free seat. Add a table or give one more seats.
seat.noRoom_other: No table has {{count, number}} free seats together. Add a table or give one more seats.
seat.venueFull: The venue is at its capacity: nobody more can be seated here.
seat.chairHelp: For printed place cards. Moving a guest clears it unless you choose one here.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: The table goes from this plan. Nobody is seated at it.
remove.occupiedBody: Unseat or move everyone at this table before removing it.

status.unpublished: Guests no longer see their tables.

errors.seats: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
errors.count: Enter a whole number from 1 to 200.
errors.belowSeated: Guests are seated here: make it at least that many.
errors.nameTaken: Another table in this plan has this name.
errors.chairsOutside: Guests sit at numbered chairs beyond this: move them first.

problems.other: This couldn’t be done. Reload the page and try again.

forbidden.addTable: Your role can see the seating but not add tables.
forbidden.editTable: Your role can see the seating but not change tables.
forbidden.removeTable: Your role can see the seating but not remove tables.
forbidden.seat: Your role can see the seating but not seat guests.
forbidden.unseat: Your role can see the seating but not unseat guests.
forbidden.start: Your role can see the seating but not run automatic seating.
forbidden.publish: Your role can see the seating but not change what guests see.

missing.plan: This venue’s plan is no longer there. The page is up to date again.
missing.table: This table was removed meanwhile. The page is up to date again.
missing.seat: The table or the guest is no longer there. The page is up to date again.
missing.notSeated: They were no longer seated here. The page is up to date again.
missing.event: This event is no longer available.

conflict.tableFull: That table filled up meanwhile. The tables are up to date again: choose another.
conflict.venueFull: The venue is at its capacity: nobody more can be seated here.
conflict.tableMoved: That table moved to another venue meanwhile. The page is up to date again.
conflict.chairTaken: That chair was taken meanwhile. The page is up to date again.
conflict.seat: The seating changed meanwhile. The page is up to date again; try again.
conflict.tableOccupied: Guests are seated at this table now. Unseat them before removing it.
conflict.chairOutside: That chair is past the table’s seats. The page is up to date again.
conflict.venueHasGuests: Guests or freed seats are on this table. Move them and dismiss the notes, then change its venue.

plan.title: Drawn plan
plan.lead: Where each table stands in the room. Only you and your team see this; guests see their own table’s name. Drag a table, or press it and use the arrows.
plan.noTables: No tables on this plan yet. Add them under “Tables and guests”, then place them here.
